headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a 5-2 defeat at the hands of the Cleveland Guardians, with Ryan Jeffers leading the Twins' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the Philadelphia Phillies in a close game, securing a 2-1 win behind Max Muncy's home run and 2 RBIs. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, securing a 12-2 victory led by Nick Fortes' 3 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Baltimore Orioles placed catcher Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation, effective retroactive to July 20, 2026. Other notable injuries include J.T. Ginn (Athletics) with a right middle finger blister, Stephen Kolek (Kansas City Royals) with a right flexor strain, and Bobby Witt Jr. (Kansas City Royals) with low back tightness.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, shaking up teams' lineups. The Houston Astros acquired right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade with the Kansas City Royals. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash.
